shortDescription: This module manages volume migration between clusters on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: new_pool
options.description: Specifies the pool on which the volume has to be migrated. Valid only when I(type_of_migration=across_pools).

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user on the local system.

options.name: relationship_name
options.description: Name of the migration relationship. Required when I(state=initiate) or I(state=switch).

options.name: remote_cluster
options.description: Specifies the name of the remote cluster. Required when I(state=initiate).

options.name: remote_password
options.description: REST API password for the partner Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(remote_username) and I(remote_password) are required if not using I(remote_token) to authenticate a user on the partner system. Valid when I(state=initiate).

options.name: remote_pool
options.description: Specifies the pool on which the volume on Partner Spectrum Virtualize storage system should get created. Required when I(state=initiate).

options.name: remote_token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the partner Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module. Valid when I(state=initiate).

options.name: remote_username
options.description: REST API username for the partner Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(remote_username) and I(remote_password) are required if not using I(remote_token) to authenticate a user on the partner system. Valid when C(state=initiate).

options.name: remote_validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification for partner Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when I(state=initiate).

options.name: replicate_hosts
options.description: Replicates the hosts mapped to a source volume on the source system, to the target system, and maps the hosts to the target volume. The user can use ibm_svc_host and ibm_svc_vol_map modules to create and map hosts to the target volume for an existing migration relationship. Valid when I(state=initiate).

options.name: source_volume
options.description: Specifies the name of the existing source volume to be used in migration. Required when I(state=initiate) or I(state=cleanup) or I(type_of_migration=across_pools).

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the different states of the migration process when I(type_of_migration=across_clusters). C(initiate), creates a volume on remote cluster; optionally used to replicate hosts, and to create and start a migration relationship. C(switch), switches the migration relationship direction allowing write access on the target volume. C(cleanup), deletes the source volume and migration relationship after a 'switch'.

options.name: target_volume
options.description: Specifies the name of the volume to be created on the target system. Required when I(state=initiate).

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: type_of_migration
options.description: Specifies the type of migration whether it is migration across pools or migration across clusters

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user on the local system.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification.
